questions.prompt: Input height 9, kernel 3, stride 2, padding 1. What is the output height?
A layer maps a (N, 16, 32, 32) input to 64 output channels with 3×3 kernels. What shape are the weights?
questions.explanation: Each of the 64 filters spans all 16 input channels, so the weights are (F, C, KH, KW) = (64, 16, 3, 3).

questions.prompt: Your conv matches a reference only when the kernel is symmetric. What's the likely bug?
options: The kernel is flipped (true convolution instead of cross-correlation)
questions.explanation: Flipping a symmetric kernel changes nothing, so the bug only shows up with asymmetric kernels. Conv2d computes cross-correlation, with no flip.

questions.prompt: In max-pool backward, a 2×2 window's values are [1, 7; 3, 2] and its upstream gradient is 5. What gradient does each input get?
questions.explanation: Only the max influenced the output, so it receives the full gradient. The other three get 0.
